Slide 1 — Title: Welcome to [Company Name] Customer Onboarding
- Purpose: align on goals, timeline, and success criteria
- Expected outcomes: go-live plan, responsibilities, first 90-day metrics
- Presenter & primary contact details

Slide 2 — Agenda
- Onboarding objectives and success definition
- High-level timeline and key milestones
- Roles, responsibilities, and communication cadence

Slide 3 — About Us
- Mission, core capabilities, and industry focus
- Relevant customer successes / references
- Security, compliance, and data-handling commitments

Slide 4 — Product Overview
- Core features that address your key needs
- Integration points, technical requirements, and dependencies
- Customization options and usage examples

Slide 5 — Onboarding Plan
- Kickoff & discovery: workshops, data collection, timelines
- Implementation & training: configuration, migration, enablement
- Go-live & validation: acceptance criteria, pilot users, rollback plan

Slide 6 — Next Steps & Support
- Immediate actions, key dates, and ownership
- Primary contacts, support channels, and escalation path
- Success metrics, review cadence, and continuous-improvement loop
